data.summary: RM-tool-diet-research (a docs-only research item) cannot be claimed: 'phase P-harness-adapters has 1 open task(s) (inherited from P-agent-parity)'. Research items should not inherit phase needs, or claim should offer a reasoned override.

Accuracy of action-enum tools is THEORETICAL; Cursor 40 and Windsurf 100 caps are CLAIMED; the BFCL citation is REFUTED.
